messages.text: what can you tell me about my current project?

This is an early-stage **portfolio website** for **John Agburu (Illustrator X Graphic Designer)** — a fresh Next.js 16.4.5 app built with pnpm. Here's the rundown:

**Stack**
- Next.js 16.4.5 (App Router) + React 19.3 + TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS v4 (Turbopack), shadcn-style setup (`components.json`, Base UI, CVA, lucide-react)
- Fonts: Space Grotesk + JetBrains Mono; a stark off-white/ink (#eee/#141414) "neo-brutalist" design language with hard 2.5px borders and offset hover shadows

**Structure** (`src/`)
- `app/` — Home (hero with SVG title lockup + greyscale→color portrait hover), plus `/illustrations`, `/projects`, `/journal`, `/other-work`
- `components/` — `Navbar`, `HeroTitleSvg`, `ContactModal`, `ResumeModal`, a `ui/button`
- `context/` — ResumeModalContext + ContactModalContext (persistent modals mounted in root layout, so they're reachable from any page)

**State**
- 6 commits; most recent added the illustrations page with filtering/grid
- **Uncommitted changes**: modified `.gitignore` and `src/app/illustrations/page.tsx`
- Several folders (`hooks`, `data`, `config`, `types`, `sections`) are still empty placeholders, so the illustrations/projects/journal pages likely have stubbed or in-progress content

**Quirks worth knowing**
- AGENTS.md warns this Next.js version has breaking changes vs. typical training data — check `node_modules/next/dist/docs/` before writing code
- Layout is an `h-dvh` locked viewport shell with internal scroll areas (no whole-page scroll on desktop)

Want me to dig into the uncommitted illustrations changes or any specific page?
